newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Investors move to July in ODP.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Investors move to July in ODP.

text.p: Office Depot Inc options were extremely busy Friday as investors began taking positions in the July series, with some moving out of June positions, as they wait for the decision on Office Depot's planned merger with Staples Inc, traders said.
Among the biggest trades, one institution did a June/July put spread 6,000 times, buying the July 15 puts and selling the June 15 puts.
"They're probably thinking that nothing's going to happen in the next two weeks," the head of one options desk said, referring to the institution that put on the put spread.

By the end of the day, the June 15 put had traded more than 13,500 contracts and the July 15 put had traded nearly 12,000 contracts. Open interest in the June 15 put was about 18,700 and 20,500 in the July 15 put.
June options expire in two weeks.
Office Depot shares bucked the broad market trend by losing 3/8 to 17-3/8.
Investors have been expecting a ruling by mid-June from a U.S. District Court on the Federal Trade Commission's suit aimed at halting the proposed merger.
U.S. District Judge Thomas Hogan presided over a five-day hearing in late May and said he would rule by mid-June on whether to grant the government a preliminary injunction to halt the merger.
Traders said that in addition to the large put spread, investors were moving out of June 17-1/2 and 20 calls into July.
The June 17-1/2 call traded 4,150 contracts and the June 20 call traded 2,965.
Action in the July calls was led by the July 20, which traded about 9,280 contracts.
The July 15 call traded nearly 7,100 contracts, the 17-1/2 call traded 6,450 contracts and the July 22-1/2 call traded about 3,850.
The July 15, 17-1/2 and 20 calls already have heavy open interest, led by the 17-1/2, which had more than 55,000 contracts open through Thursday.
The July 15 calls had open interest of about 44,325 and the July 20s had open interest of roughly 46,155.
Traders said Office Depot July options have been busy since late May.
